verdict.rationale: The docs are versioned per release: there is a version dropdown to switch between versions [typesense-docs-53], and API references live under versioned paths such as /docs/latest/api/ [typesense-docs-45]. That implies the API surface is tracked by version, but the evidence says nothing about a deprecation policy or explicit API versioning guarantees. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, explicit API versioning scheme or stability guarantees, changelog/migration guidance for breaking changes, independent corroboration.
